tasks.title: Layout/spacing/icon consistency audit + WhatsApp & warehouses activation review
tasks.brief: Extra focus requested by owner Ahmed, on top of UX21 and after the UX22-UX36 fix tasks (read .nova/qa/ux-pro2-report.md and .nova/inbox/ux-pro2.json first; do NOT duplicate UX22+ tasks, extend them instead). Audit the ux-pro1 frontend locally (Playwright, desktop 1366x768 + mobile 390x844, fake data, no live writes). PART 1 Layout: on EVERY screen/page/modal check element distribution and placement, use of space (wasted space, crowding, uneven gaps, overflow, scroll where none needed), visual hierarchy, grid alignment, consistent spacing scale, card/button sizes, and consistency of ALL icons (same set/style/stroke/size, meaning, alignment with labels, RTL mirroring). Produce a per-screen table (الشاشة | توزيع العناصر | المساحة | الأيقونات | المشكلة | الحل) with screenshots in .nova/qa/ux-pro2b/ (max ~30 PNGs). PART 2 Activation: review the WhatsApp feature (integrations/whatsapp/inbox.html, unified-inbox.js, msg-policy.js, backend/src/whatsapp-intake.js, backend/src/inbox.js) and the warehouses/stores/stock-locations feature (find all related code: stores, branches, stock locations, transfers, purchases/procurement). For each: what works today, what is hidden behind flags or stubbed, exact steps and what is missing to fully activate it (UI, backend endpoint, flag, secret/credential names only, WhatsApp provider/API needs, cost if any), risks. Write findings to .nova/qa/ux-pro2b-report.md in Arabic with a clear «خطة التفعيل» section per feature. Then write .nova/inbox/ux-pro2b.json = {"tasks":[...]} ids starting UX40: small frontend-only layout/icon fix tasks (max 12, with tests) plus activation tasks that need NO new secrets and NO paid services and keep backend flags OFF by default (code + tests only, behind flags); anything needing a secret, paid service, or flag ON goes only in the report as an owner decision. If ux-pro2.json's final artifact-rebuild task exists, set its `after` dependency note in the report (do not edit cloud-queue.json); add your own final task rebuilding worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro2b.js after all your other ids, must NOT deploy. Commit report, screenshots and inbox file on this branch.
tasks.acceptance: Arabic report .nova/qa/ux-pro2b-report.md with per-screen layout/space/icon table + screenshots and activation plans for WhatsApp and warehouses; valid .nova/inbox/ux-pro2b.json with UX40+ tasks (no secrets, no paid services, flags off, no deploy) and a final no-deploy artifact rebuild; no live writes.
